Publishes gossip chunks and advances the chunk pointer after range checks.

# Purpose
[`fd_gossip_out_get_chunk`](<#fd_gossip_out_get_chunk>) returns the local address of the current output chunk by converting `ctx->chunk` with `fd_chunk_to_laddr`. [`fd_gossip_tx_publish_chunk`](<#fd_gossip_tx_publish_chunk>) checks that the chunk range and message size are valid, then publishes the chunk with `fd_stem_publish` and advances `ctx->chunk` to the next compacted chunk with `fd_dcache_compact_next`. This file therefore provides the small output-side helper logic used to read and publish gossip data from a chunked memory area.
